generators.name: Gridfinity Layout Tool
generators.summary: Plan and design Gridfinity drawer organizer layouts for 3D printing, with a layout planner, bin designer, baseplate generator, 3D preview and print list.

distributions.label: Install offline copy
distributions.notes: Built from each upstream release. The Bins and Baseplate tabs are included; sign-in, sharing and community designs need the online site.

generators.name: Gridfinity Bin Designer
generators.summary: Parametric Gridfinity bin generator with STL export. Offline, use the Bins tab of the Gridfinity Layout Tool's offline copy.

generators.name: Gridfinity Baseplate Generator
generators.summary: 3D-printable Gridfinity baseplates with automatic splitting and STL, STEP and 3MF export. Offline, use the Baseplate tab of the Gridfinity Layout Tool's offline copy.
